scope: Observed desktop browser interaction through CUA Cloud Chrome on the immutable Vercel deployment. Not a device, mobile, learning or full-game qualification.

attempts.reason: Browser access requires the originating browser context

testedDeployment.hashVerificationOwner: Publication coordinator; this front inspected rendered UI.
testedDeployment.retestScope: Opening without fragment and direct #overview / #schedule anchors only; prior functional observations remain attached to the initial deployment.

observations.observed: The URL normalized to #overview; native fragment positioning placed the initial heading behind the sticky header. First screenshot showed only the lower title line. Control+Home restored the full hero.

observations.action: Measure visible header and switch to Cronograma from page top
observations.observed: Read-only DOM observation: header position sticky, height 66px, top 0. Cronograma heading and controls were fully visible after this tab switch.

14 of 18 tasks shown for Até o corte. Legend, owners by track and planned/blocked/completed distinctions rendered. Short task bars truncate text and retain tooltips; the list is the readable alternative.

observations.action: Combine Bloqueado and Candidatura ao Space Apps filters; switch to list
observations.observed: One task remained, Resolver elegibilidade temporal e Resources. Its title, owner, dates, track and local checkbox were readable.
Native modal showed status, owner, time window, dependencies, acceptance criteria and evidence paths. Focus was reported on the close button. Closing restored the task button.

observations.action: Check personal confirmation and close modal
observations.observed: Personal progress changed from 0/18 to 1/18; official status remained 7 completed of 18 at the documented cutoff. The checkbox was subsequently unchecked, restoring local 0/18.

observations.action: Select all phases and search for a nonexistent task
observations.observed: 0 of 18 tasks and explicit empty-state text. Clearing the query restored 18 of 18 tasks.

observations.action: Open Contexto completo and follow the integral library link
observations.observed: Context section exposed 14 chapters and the library opened with 43 documents, provenance text, Markdown download, index/hash link and print control.

observations.action: Search library for Schema Prisma and select document 07
observations.observed: The index reduced to 5 of 43 documents. Selection updated the fragment and exposed document 07 with its source/hash metadata and readable relational-model table. Read-only DOM confirmed document 01 display none and document 07 display block.

observations.action: Return to central and follow Jogar
observations.observed: Game observatory opened with introductory copy, long/short contact choices, source controls and mission-start control. This was an opening check, not a complete mission run.

Sample included browser-extension metadata errors and THREE.WebGLRenderer context-creation errors reporting GL_RENDERER Disabled. These do not establish performance on AB hardware; 3D acceleration was not qualified.

observations.action: Return to central and conclude browser phase
observations.observed: Central #overview was marked as the user-facing deliverable. CUA completion_summary was sent. No external message, login, build or source edit occurred in this browser phase.

findings.description: Initial #overview heading is partly occluded by the 66px sticky header.
findings.reproduction: Open the central entry URL without a fragment in a fresh navigation.
findings.recommendation: Account for sticky-header height in fragment positioning and preserve deep-link destinations; coordinator is applying the fix.
findings.resolution: Coordinator published anchor-offset and initialization correction; the narrow browser retest above observed the title below the sticky header in all requested cases.

screenshots.note: Screenshots were inspected in the browser tool output only. No screenshot file was placed in the versioned project or deliverable ZIP.

limitations: The corrected deployment received only the requested anchor/title retest. Other interaction observations belong to the initial deployment and were not repeated after the scoped visual fix.
Desktop Cloud Chrome only; no mobile layout, screen reader, keyboard-complete accessibility audit or print-output inspection.
No benchmark or rehearsal on AB equipment, no FPS or GPU qualification, no cold-offline run.
No human learning study or contest eligibility decision.
Game opening was inspected; no new full mission or scientific validation was performed.
The error log sample was limited to 20 recent error/warning entries; it is not a complete console audit.
